Recommendations

Range long → Increase cruise_gamma_deg or start terminal dive earlier.
High AoA → Reduce pitch rate command or check CG-CP margin.
Sideslip → Increase yaw damping gain or check fin alignment.
Pitch oscillation → Tune MPC weights or add rate feedback.
G-load → Reduce maneuver aggressiveness in pitch program.
Shallow impact → Start terminal dive earlier or steeper dive angle.
⚠ SERVO DELAY: Under-compensated — increase delay_steps in rocket_properties.yaml (lookahead_stage auto-computes). For HIL/flight: set RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY = measured delay in seconds (e.g. 0.080 for 80ms → lookahead_stage=4)
